title: P22: the new R1 fix passed a directory as a clean log (found by its own control); the chain header label p20-chain-final is stale
what_went_wrong: p15_oracle_batch_failed checked -r and -s only; for a directory both are true and grep exits 2, which read as 'none'. p22_a_negctl.sh failed 1 of 25 on its first pre-flight.
p22_chain.sh was derived from p20_chain.sh and kept the string p20-chain-final in the live-state capture label; the final capture is correct, its header is not.
root_cause: R1 was written from the case I had in mind (missing and empty file); the control also covered a directory because it was planned from the helper's inputs, not from my fix. The label was not grepped for 'p20' after the derivation.
detection: First pre-flight of p22_a_negctl.sh; the label while writing R5 section 34.
impact: None on results; the first run is kept as evidence/p22/preflight/p22_a_preflight1.txt.

correction.applied: helper now requires a regular file and treats grep rc 2 as FAILED; re-run 25/25. The label is disclosed, the frozen wrapper not changed.

rule: After deriving a wrapper from another, grep the new file for the old wave's name; plan a control per input class of the fixed function (missing, empty, directory, unreadable), not only the case that motivated the fix.
